front: Microwave links: how are they used?
back: Point-to-point links between dishes on towers (line of sight needed) and links to satellites.

front: Why are radio waves used for broadcasting?
back: They travel long distances and pass through walls, so one transmitter reaches many receivers.

front: Satellite communication: one benefit, two drawbacks?
back: Reaches remote areas with no cables or masts; but expensive and the long path causes delay (also storms).
